trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. Before the rollback, v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west. All three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The SEV2 for checkout-api says v2.3.1 broke health checks and that we rolled back to v2.3.0. The system confirmed it was created, but it didn't return an incident ID. I didn't open it again, so you won't get a duplicate.

One thing to follow up: the test version of v2.3.1 was already failing in staging before it went to production. I put this in the incident and suggested finding the root cause of v2.3.1 and checking why it was released despite failing staging.
